feature: Native-clocked monitor metronome for macOS Live playback
implementation: Existing musical controls supply initial and live click settings; enable/level changes preserve DSP topology.
48 kHz absolute project-frame arithmetic supplies bar accents, fractional beat periods, seeks and within-block cycle wrap.
Clicks are mixed after project effects, meters and loudness; they do not enter export graphs.
Output uses the existing native queue, selected device and monitor volume; monitor sum saturates at full scale.
Malformed music packets are rejected before replacing pending mix controls.
limits: Native Preview and prepared recording backing still omit clicks.
Tempo, time-signature and origin edits remain structural playback restarts.
Live changes reach output after already queued PCM; no claim of sample-accurate control events.
No fresh hardware listening, physical iOS or commercial plug-in acceptance; existing playback acceptance remains unchanged.
No App Store/TestFlight submission or release tag.
